# Security Policy

This repository does not currently maintain a formal security policy or dedicated security reporting process.

These projects are community-created mods for **Project Hospital** and are not intended to provide security-sensitive functionality.

If you discover a security-related issue directly caused by one of these mods, please report it through the usual support channel for the affected mod.

Please do not use this repository to report security issues related to:

* Project Hospital itself
* BepInEx
* Harmony / HarmonyLib
* Unity
* Steam
* GitHub
* Any other third-party software or service

Security issues affecting third-party software should be reported directly to the corresponding developer or vendor.

## Supported Versions

No mod version is formally supported under a security maintenance policy.

Updates and fixes may be released when appropriate, but no security support or response timeframe is guaranteed.
